findings.mechanism: The page consumes selected vehicle but no useRangeState, and calls useClimateHistory(vehicleIdStr) with no start/end. The existing climateHistory key and URL contain vehicle only. /cabin-thermal is absent from RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS, so the shared header/mobile date range is disabled rather than controlling this dated analysis. Neither bound is consumed; there is no local selector competing with the header.

steps: Change both URL bounds or navigate from a workspace-range-owning route.
The page still supplies only '7'; query identity and /climate?vehicle_id=7 have neither bound, and route scope.range is false.

findings.fix: Reuse existing useRangeState and header/mobile ownership. Integration owner extends existing typed history hook/key with both instants, registers the actual route, verifies both server-side bounds, then page forwards both. Preserve unscoped existing callers, signal cancellation, enablement, safeArray, all gates and source-local states; truthfully update default-seven-day captions. No loaded-row-only filtering or second date picker.

findings.mechanism: Four timestamp calls pass only locale derived from i18n.language. formatDateTime uses browser timezone unless opts.tz is supplied, and locale-specific formatting with fixed date/time fields. These calls do not consume settings.locale, tz_display_default or the resolved vehicle/user/UTC zone. The already-existing useDateFormat hook resolves saved locale and timezone; no shared API extension is needed.

steps: Use UI language en and save locale de-DE with tz_display_default=utc; browser zone America/Los_Angeles.
The current calls format using UI-language conventions and browser-zone prior day, not saved UTC/saved locale.

findings.fix: Adopt existing useDateFormat or bound formatter props for all four calls. Keep precise source instants, full timestamp content and explicit absolute evidence-date semantics; disclose effective zone where interpretation depends on it. Review saved relative/absolute and locale-derived 12/24-hour policy with existing owner rather than inventing a new formatter.
findings.limits: Actual preference changes and browser timezone output NOTRUN. A separate explicit 12/24-hour setting was not established from inspected sources; no invented setting or claim that absolute evidence dates must become relative.

findings.mechanism: The page threads i18n.language as numeric locale to formatTemperatureDelta and explicit fmtScientificNumber overrides. Those explicit overrides bypass the saved numeric locale used by useNumberFormatting/useUnits. Thus saved number conventions differ between deltas/slopes and adjacent counts/absolute temperatures. Precision is NOT lost: the delta helper reads getGlobalPrecision and scientific formatting retains a minimum diagnostic precision.

steps: Keep UI language en, save locale de-DE and decimal_precision=2.
Inspect a signed -1.25 Celsius initial gap or a fractional fitted slope.
Explicit English locale prints decimal point in the affected delta/slope while saved-locale counts/temperatures use German number conventions.

findings.fix: Use the existing reactive formatting locale (or unitPrefs.locale for physical displays); do not use translation language as number locale. Reuse the existing SI delta formatter if consolidating the local duplicate. Keep Fahrenheit difference scale without absolute offset, signed values and diagnostic minimum precision.

findings.mechanism: Before history resolves the page intentionally analyzes [] to build safe shells. Four population-specific rendered copies read that zero summary outside a resolved-state gate: directory cap, accepted cap, methodology numeric notice, and normalized-row metric description. Therefore initial-paused/loading/fatal/no-vehicle states can assert zero populations although no response established zero. Main KPI raw values correctly remain null and SectionBody correctly keeps passive unresolved states; these good gates do not gate the captions/metric descriptions.

Directory displays Showing0 of0 candidates; accepted directory shows0; methodology notice interpolates0 returned rows/0 windows; normalized description says0 rows excluded. Pause status itself says no empty response is inferred.

findings.fix: Keep all shells/methodology text and actions. Gate only population-dependent copy on vehicleSelected && isResolved && !error; use truthful unresolved text before resolution. Thread trust to methodology or separate its static explanation from numeric notice. Gate the metric description as well as raw/context values. Retained successful empty/nonempty evidence continues using real counts on failure/paused refresh.
